features.name: Three bonus modes

review:
Punk Rocker 2 is a 6x3 sequel where two bonus symbols trigger Riot Respins: the bonus symbols become Molotov Wilds and lock their reels. The bonus comes in three flavours, DisOBEY, ChAos and Mass Transit BBQ Spins, each with different numbers of jumping wilds and train enhancers.

xWays adds symbol stacks. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 30,144x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
